description: The Biden-Harris Administration’s dangerous open border policies have created one of the worst humanitarian crises in our nation’s history, letting criminals, fentanyl, and human traffickers freely pour across the border and putting our communities at risk. We must support President Trump in his efforts and pass real legislation to secure the border, finish the wall, and give Border Patrol agents the resources they need to keep our families safe.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY JAKE ELLZEY FOR CONGRESS Jake Ellzey is a retired member of the United States Navy
title: Secure Our Border - Jake Ellzey for Congress
